targets.summary: The code added at this line looks unnecessary and should be removed.
targets.evidence: Before, line 350 read `if not torch.cuda.is_available():` followed by `return`. The merged diff deletes both lines (`-        if not torch.cuda.is_available():` / `-            return`). The test is also split: `test_my_is_pinned_cpu_false` (marked @onlyCPU) and a new `test_my_is_pinned_cuda_true` marked @onlyCUDA. The CUDA test uses `torch.randn(2, 3, device="cpu", pin_memory=True)`. The runtime CUDA check is gone and the decorator now handles that gating, so the extra code the maintainer flagged was removed.
